name: cold-email-writer
description: Write short B2B cold emails, subject lines and follow-ups from your offer, audience and proof. Review the brief, compare three variants and export a sequence. It writes text only: it never sends email or finds contacts. By ASTUDIO.

interface.longDescription: Cold Email Writer helps founders, sales teams and B2B consultants write short, relevant outreach. Add your offer, target buyer, pain point and proof, approve the brief, compare three first-email options and create one to three useful follow-ups. Export the finished sequence as Markdown or CSV. It writes text only. It never sends email, accesses inboxes, scrapes contacts or promises replies.
defaultPrompt: Write a cold email sequence for my B2B offer.
Give me three cold email subject lines and first-email options.
Create two useful follow-ups for my cold outreach.

positive.description: A direct B2B outreach request uses the complete guided flow.
positive.prompt: Write a cold email sequence for my B2B scheduling product.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect missing facts, require approval, show three variants, and select only after explicit choice.

positive.description: A concise request gets a brief without invented company facts.
positive.prompt: I need a cold email for CFOs at logistics companies.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for the offer, pain point, proof and one call to action before drafting.

positive.description: Approved brief creates short variants and relevant follow-ups.
positive.prompt: Approve the brief and draft the sequence.
positive.expected_behavior: Create three first emails under 120 words with follow-ups under 60 words and one CTA each.

positive.description: Personalisation tokens are checked before selection.
positive.expected_behavior: Report missing or malformed tokens and preserve the selected valid variant.

positive.description: An explicit selection exports Markdown and CSV.
positive.prompt: Select variant two and export it as Markdown and CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Require selection and export the exact chosen sequence without retaining it.

negative.prompt: Send this sequence to my prospect list.
Find 500 SaaS founders and their email addresses.
Make up a customer result so this sounds more credible.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products, buy media, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with a guided brief, approval checkpoint, three cold-email variants, follow-ups, and local export.
